mission_01: Congratulations! You've mastered the fundamentals of deduplication in pandas. By using drop_duplicates(), you learned how to identify and remove redundant rows from a DataFrame. This skill is crucial in real-world data pipelines where duplicate records can skew analytics, inflate metrics, and waste storage. You now understand how the 'keep' parameter controls which duplicate is retained, and you can verify your cleaning with duplicated().sum(). These techniques form the foundation of data quality assurance in any data science workflow.
